title.fr: La même loi pour tout le monde

summary.en: Walk along the river with the officer. You stop at the footbridge, at the Canadian Museum for Human Rights and at the maple tree, and at each one you learn something about the law here and then answer questions about it.
summary.fr: Marchez le long de la rivière avec l'agent. Vous vous arrêtez à la passerelle, au Musée canadien pour les droits de la personne et à l'érable; à chaque halte, vous apprenez une chose sur la loi d'ici, puis vous répondez à des questions dessus.

text.en: That is all right. I will be here by the river when you are ready.
text.fr: C'est correct. Je serai ici, au bord de la rivière, quand vous voudrez.

text.en: No need to hurry. Each stop along the river is about the law here. Your task on the screen says what to do now.
text.fr: Inutile de vous presser. Chaque halte le long de la rivière porte sur la loi d'ici. Votre mission à l'écran indique ce qu'il faut faire maintenant.

text.en: You can also ask questions about how we do our police work. Almost every police force has a way to hear your concerns.
text.fr: Vous pouvez aussi poser des questions sur notre travail de police. Presque tous les corps de police ont un moyen de recevoir vos préoccupations.

source.quote: You can also question the police about their service or conduct if you feel you need to. Almost all police forces in Canada have a process by which you can bring your concerns to the police and seek action.

verification.evidence: You can also question the police about their service or conduct if you feel you need to. Almost all police forces in Canada have a process by which you can bring your concerns to the police and seek action.

text.en: You walked beside the river with me, out onto the footbridge, up to the Canadian Museum for Human Rights and on to the maple tree. Three stops, and the walk is over.
text.fr: Vous avez longé la rivière avec moi, jusqu'à la passerelle, puis au Musée canadien pour les droits de la personne et à l'érable. Trois haltes, et la marche est terminée.

prompt.en: Meet the officer by the river
prompt.fr: Retrouvez l'agent au bord de la rivière

text.en: Good day. I walk this riverbank most mornings. Come along with me.
text.fr: Bonjour. Je longe cette rive presque tous les matins. Venez avec moi.

text.en: Here, a person in a criminal case is innocent until it is proven that they are guilty.
text.fr: Ici, une personne dans une affaire criminelle est innocente jusqu'à ce qu'on prouve sa culpabilité.

source.quote: Our judicial system is founded on the presumption of innocence in criminal matters, meaning everyone is innocent until proven guilty.

verification.evidence: Our judicial system is founded on the presumption of innocence in criminal matters, meaning everyone is innocent until proven guilty.

text.en: The police are here to keep people safe. You can ask us for help after an accident, or if something of yours is stolen.
text.fr: La police est là pour garder les gens en sécurité. Vous pouvez nous demander de l'aide après un accident, ou si on vous vole quelque chose.

source.quote: The police are there to keep people safe and to enforce the law. You can ask the police for help in all kinds of situations—if there’s been an accident, if someone has stolen something from you

verification.evidence: The police are there to keep people safe and to enforce the law. You can ask the police for help in all kinds of situations—if there’s been an accident, if someone has stolen something from you, if you are a victim of assault, if you see a crime taking place or if someone you know has gone missing.

text.en: We stop three times along the river. I will explain one thing at each stop, and then ask you about it.
text.fr: On fait trois haltes le long de la rivière. J'expliquerai une chose à chaque halte, puis je vous poserai des questions dessus.

prompt.en: Answer 4 questions about the courts, the prisons and what the law does not allow
prompt.fr: Répondez à 4 questions sur les tribunaux, les prisons et ce que la loi ne tolère pas

text.en: A bridge is built to reach people who are not you. Keep that in your head for this next one.
text.fr: Une passerelle est bâtie pour rejoindre des gens qui ne sont pas vous. Gardez cela en tête pour la suite.

text.en: Laws here have more than one job. They keep order. They give people a peaceful way to settle an argument. And they say out loud what matters to Canadians and what Canadians believe.
text.fr: Les lois ici ont plus d'un rôle. Elles maintiennent l'ordre. Elles donnent aux gens un moyen pacifique de régler un différend. Et elles disent tout haut ce qui compte pour les Canadiens et ce en quoi ils croient.

source.quote: Our laws are intended to provide order in society and a peaceful way to settle disputes, and to express the values and beliefs of Canadians.

verification.evidence: Canada is governed by an organized system of laws. These laws are the written rules intended to guide people in our society. They are made by elected representatives. The courts settle disputes and the police enforce the laws. The law in Canada applies to everyone, including judges, politicians and the police. Our laws are intended to provide order in society and a peaceful way to settle disputes, and to express the values and beliefs of Canadians.

prompt.en: Answer 3 questions about what laws are for, who makes them and the promise to obey them
prompt.fr: Répondez à 3 questions sur le rôle des lois, sur qui les fait et sur la promesse de les respecter

text.en: This is the stop that matters most. Take it slowly.
text.fr: C'est la halte la plus importante. Prenez votre temps.

text.en: Due process means the government must respect every legal right you have under the law. Not most of them. All of them.
text.fr: L'application régulière de la loi veut dire que le gouvernement doit respecter tous les droits que la loi vous reconnaît. Pas la plupart. Tous.

source.quote: Due process is the principle that the government must respect all of legal rights a person is entitled to under the law.

verification.evidence: Canada’s legal system is based on a heritage that includes the rule of law, freedom under the law, democratic principles and due process. Due process is the principle that the government must respect all of legal rights a person is entitled to under the law.

prompt.en: Answer 5 questions about your rights before the law
prompt.fr: Répondez à 5 questions sur vos droits devant la loi

prompt.en: Walk on to the maple tree

text.en: One last thing, and it is a practical one. What you can pay should not decide this.
text.fr: Une dernière chose, et elle est bien concrète. Ce que vous pouvez payer ne devrait pas décider de cela.

text.en: A lawyer can act for you in court. If you cannot pay for one, most communities have legal aid, free or close to it.
text.fr: Un avocat peut vous représenter devant le tribunal. Si vous ne pouvez pas le payer, la plupart des localités offrent l'aide juridique, gratuite ou presque.

source.quote: Lawyers can help you with legal problems and act for you in court. If you cannot pay for a lawyer, in most communities there are legal aid services available free of charge or at a low cost.

verification.evidence: GETTING LEGAL HELP Lawyers can help you with legal problems and act for you in court. If you cannot pay for a lawyer, in most communities there are legal aid services available free of charge or at a low cost.

prompt.en: Answer 3 questions about the police and getting legal help
prompt.fr: Répondez à 3 questions sur la police et sur l'aide juridique
